categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou Tigermed Consulting Co., Ltd. primarily operates as a Contract Research Organization (CRO) providing comprehensive clinical trial services for new drug development. Its main business segments include clinical trial technical services such as clinical operations, pharmacology, regulatory affairs, medical translation, pharmacovigilance, real-world research, and third-party audits and training. Additionally, it offers clinical trial-related and laboratory services including data management, statistical analysis, site management, patient recruitment, medical imaging, and laboratory testing, with laboratory services mainly conducted by its subsidiary Frontage Holdings.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced digital and intelligent technologies including AI, decentralized clinical trials (DCT), risk-based quality management (RBQM), and remote monitoring platforms to enhance clinical trial efficiency and quality. It has developed proprietary AI models and platforms for medical translation, clinical trial design optimization, patient recruitment, data management, and medical writing. The integration of digital and smart technologies is a strategic focus to innovate clinical research processes and reduce costs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tigermed serves global pharmaceutical and medical device innovators, including multinational pharmaceutical companies, domestic large pharmaceutical firms, and small to medium-sized biotech startups. Its customers span various therapeutic areas such as oncology, respiratory, infectious diseases, endocrinology, hematology, neurology, cardiovascular, dermatology, immunology, digestive diseases, metabolic disorders, and rare diseases. The company supports clients in China and overseas markets including North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and emerging markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with subsidiaries and teams across more than 30 countries covering Asia-Pacific (China, Korea, Japan, Southeast Asia, Australia), North America (USA, Canada), Europe (multiple countries including Italy, Germany, UK, Poland, Spain), Latin America (Mexico, Colombia, Brazil, Chile), Africa (South Africa), and others. It has established local clinical teams and global synchronized project management capabilities, with a significant presence in China and expanding international operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tigermed operates primarily as a midstream service provider in the pharmaceutical and medical device R&D supply chain, offering outsourced clinical research and development services. It acts as a CRO facilitating clinical trials, data management, regulatory support, and laboratory testing, bridging drug/device developers and regulatory authorities to accelerate product development and market entry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include digital transformation and AI integration to enhance clinical trial efficiency and quality, global expansion to strengthen overseas market presence, and development of integrated end-to-end drug and device R&D service platforms. It invests in AI-driven platforms for clinical trial design, patient recruitment, data analytics, and medical translation. Tigermed also focuses on specialized therapeutic areas and building strategic partnerships to support innovative drug/device development globally.
categories.revenue_model: Tigermed generates revenue primarily through fee-for-service (FFS) and full-time equivalent (FTE) models by providing clinical trial technical services, data management, site management, laboratory testing, and related services. Revenue is recognized based on the progress of service delivery, either at points in time or over time, depending on contract terms. The company also earns income from investments and financial assets but mainly relies on service contracts with pharmaceutical and medical device clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tigermed is a leading CRO in China and ranks first in the domestic clinical research outsourcing market by market share. It is the only Chinese CRO consistently ranked among the global top ten. The company competes with multinational CROs and domestic mid-sized and small CROs, leveraging its extensive experience, global footprint, integrated service offerings, and advanced digital capabilities to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Tigermed reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 6.6 billion, a 10.58% decrease from 2023, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 405 million, down 79.99%. The company has over 10,000 employees worldwide and serves more than 2,800 clients globally. Despite short-term revenue decline due to industry cyclicality and competitive pressures, Tigermed continues to expand its global footprint and service capabilities, with a growing backlog of contracts and strategic acquisitions supporting long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tigermed emphasizes high-quality, end-to-end clinical research services with strong global synchronized operational capabilities. Its value proposition includes comprehensive service coverage across the entire drug and device development lifecycle, advanced digital and AI-enabled platforms to improve trial efficiency and data quality, and a broad network of strategic partnerships with clinical sites worldwide. The company’s integrated approach reduces development risks and costs, accelerates time-to-market, and supports innovative therapies’ global commercialization.
